title: Contact CAPIT | Data Corrections, Support, and Legal Notices
description: Contact CAPIT about the website, well-record corrections, media inquiries, privacy requests, and legal notices.
headline: Contact CAPIT
body: Contact CAPIT about the website, well-record corrections, media inquiries, privacy requests, or legal notices.

sections.heading: How We Can Help
sections.body: We can help with website questions, well-record corrections, broken links, content feedback, media requests, privacy requests, and legal notices.

sections.heading: Reporting a Data Issue
sections.body: Corrections are fastest when your message includes:
bullets: The well's API number or source record ID
What looks wrong, and what you believe is correct
A link to the state agency record, if you have one

sections.heading: What to Include in Your Message
sections.body: For any other request, please include:
bullets: The reason for contact: general question, data correction, media inquiry, privacy request, legal notice, or technical issue
The page or URL your message is about

sections.heading: Your Privacy
sections.body: When you contact us, we use your information only to respond to your request, as described in our [Privacy Policy](/privacy-policy).

sections.heading: What We Cannot Help With
sections.body: CAPIT cannot recover wallets, reset exchange accounts, reverse blockchain transactions, retrieve private keys, or give investment or regulatory advice. Never include private keys, wallet passwords, or secret recovery phrases in a message.
